# Do Artifacts Have Politics?

"Do Artifacts Have Politics?" is a seminal scholarly paper published by Langdon Winner in 1980.
The paper has been described as an "iconic landmark" in conversations about the relationship between technology and politics. It is often cited to illustrate the impact of neutral technology.
